description.value: Boston Pizza Dilworth Centre is a franchise location of Canada's largest casual dining chain, founded in 1964 and now celebrating 60 years of operation. Situated on Highway 97 North, it operates as both a family restaurant and a sports bar, offering a broad menu of pizza, pasta, wings, sandwiches, and more. For cyclists travelling the Okanagan corridor, it provides a familiar, high-capacity sit-down meal stop with dine-in, takeout, and delivery options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the Dilworth Centre location at #650 - 2339 Highway 97 N., Kelowna, BC with phone (250) 861-6677, matching OSM exactly. The site shows active ordering, dine-in menu, and delivery options, confirming the business is open. The menu page explicitly states 'Vegan and Glutenwise® options also available,' confirming dietary accommodations; no evidence exists for bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible restaurant on Highway 97 North — a major cycling corridor through the Okanagan. Confirmed operational via website with matching address and phone.
